description: A vendor's published Attify verification: status (Claim confirmed · within 5.0 points when Attify is 95% sure the vendor's count overstates audited outcomes by at most the claim tolerance, the gap's upper 95% limit being within it; Claim not confirmed; Lapsed; or Revoked), audited rate against the vendor's own claimed rate with 95% intervals, the gap, evidence tier, provenance (connected, or witnessed with how many counted customers' data the vendor streamed and they reconciled), the contact-reason mix (support resolution), rank within its job type, period, standard version and the signed attestation. Give the profile slug, or a name to search. Rates compare only within one job type, and for support resolution next to the contact-reason mix.

name.description: Part of the vendor's or product's name.
